# s3orchestrator_bucket (Resource)

A virtual bucket the orchestrator accepts writes under. Creating one declares a namespace; it does not create a bucket on any backend, which stays the operator's to configure.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name. It identifies every object stored beneath it, so changing it replaces the bucket.

### Optional

- `cors_rule` (Block List) A browser-facing CORS rule. The orchestrator rejects a rule that cannot match anything, because it reads as granting access the operator never gets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cors_rule))
- `max_multipart_uploads` (Number) Multipart uploads that may be in flight against this bucket at once. Zero, the default, is unlimited.

<a id="nestedblock--cors_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors_rule`

Required:

- `allowed_methods` (List of String) HTTP methods the rule permits.
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Origins the rule answers for. `*` matches any.

Optional:

- `allowed_headers` (List of String) Request headers a preflight may ask for.
- `expose_headers` (List of String) Response headers the browser may read.
- `max_age` (Number) Seconds a browser may cache the preflight answer. Zero, the default, sends no caching header at all.
